result.reason: The clause adds the preferred frequency cap, 30-day notice, business-hours limitation, independent auditor, confidentiality requirement, and 5% cost-shift threshold. However, it does not expressly prohibit direct access to Licensee systems, as the preferred position requires; limiting the audit to accounting records does not necessarily preclude system access. It also retains the broader trigger of any “discrepancy” rather than an underpayment exceeding 5%. The unnecessary relocation of the cost paragraph and the overlap between an audit being permitted “within 30 days” and requiring at least 30 days’ prior notice reduce minimality and drafting clarity. The underlying commercial intent is otherwise preserved.
